errors.text: The central methodological advance is missed: the target replaces thermodynamic integration with free-energy perturbation, whereas the generated hypothesis explicitly retains MTP-based thermodynamic integration.
The proposed N≥5 scope excludes the four-component TaVCrW target system.
Quantitative accuracy claims of less than 1 meV/atom and less than 5% experimental deviation are not supported by the cited evidence.
The requested heat-capacity prediction is not addressed.
